name: Corn grain feed; dry processing; regional mix, at farm
description: Approximation for the contribution of corn from region 3 and region 4 in the commodity market for corn fed to swine.
category: 11: Agriculture, Forestry, Fishing and Hunting/1111: Oilseed and Grain Farming

processDocumentation.timeDescription: Approximation based on the amount of corn produced in region 3 and region 4 during the years 2005-2009 based on USDA NASS cencus data from 2007.
processDocumentation.geographyDescription: This unit process represents the mixture of corn from region 3 and region 4 fed to swine in the US Swine Production Region #7, which includes the state of Iowa.
processDocumentation.technologyDescription: Includes quantities of corn from region 3 and region 4 intended to represent an average mix.
processDocumentation.inventoryMethodDescription: Life cycle inventory was originally assembled using the SimaPro software platform (Version 8.0.4.26) and was modified for submission using the OpenLCA platform (Version 1.3.0).
processDocumentation.completenessDescription: See "corn grain feed; dry processing; region 4, at farm" and "corn grain feed; dry processing; region 3, at farm" for descriptions of corn production.
processDocumentation.dataSelectionDescription: USDA NASS census data for corn production. See NASS (2007).
processDocumentation.dataTreatmentDescription: State level data aggregated to regions, which are aggregated here to represent a production mix.
processDocumentation.samplingDescription: Flow values within this dataset were obtained from the 2007 NASS Census of Agriculture.

reviews.details: University of Arkansas swine dataset mapped to USLCI technosphere flows and FEDEFL elementary flows for publication on the Federal LCA Commons. Review covers mapping crosswalks, cutoff flows, and export structure.

processDocumentation.intendedApplication: These data may be used in Situation C2, “Accounting without interactions.”  This is applicable to accounting studies that according to their goal definition do not include any interaction with other systems.  This data can be used for animal feed, corn ethanol production, and corn oil production in US Region 7. Regional irrigation practices vary a lot in different US regions. Thus, if you do not know the provenance of the corn we recommend using corn average US.

publication.name: Development of Life Cycle Inventory data for U.S. Swine Production Scenarios
